_doc: The LiteRT-LM catalog ids run_ddp_ios_lm.py takes -> the Hub repo and file the app reads, as in ios/BenchmarkApp/Sources/Models/ModelCatalog.swift (ModelCatalog.liteRTLM: hfRepoId, primaryFile; selftest.py compares the two). The file is pushed to Documents/models/litert-lm/<hfRepoId with '/' as '__'>/<file>, HFDownloader.modelDirectory's path.
